Job Description

About Glance

Glance is a consumer technology company building the future of the lock screen and ambient TV experience. Our products reach hundreds of millions of users globally, with the United States as our primary market and Japan as a growing area of focus. The Foresight & Behavioral Insights Unit decodes how consumers behave, think, and evolve — informing what product builds, how marketing positions, and how strategy evolves. We're scaling the team to bridge a critical mixed-methods capability gap and expand coverage from the US into Japan.

About the role

The Consumer Insights is a role designed to fix a long-standing operational friction: our previous structure separated quant from qual, creating handoff delays and shallow insight. This role owns the quantitative backbone of our research — segmentation, survey design, behavioral cohort identification, longitudinal tracking — and partners closely with qualitative researchers to produce integrated, mixed-methods output that stakeholders can actually act on.

You'll work across Growth, Data Science, and Leadership, with deliverables ranging from segmentation studies for product strategy, to Voice of Consumer dashboards for executive reviews, to hypothesis generation that feeds Data Science's predictive models.   • Collaborate with qualitative researchers to integrate findings into single, decision-ready narratives
  • Partner with Data Science on user profile intelligence and decision heuristics
  • Own Voice of Consumer programs — structured feedback loops, sentiment tracking, anomaly investigation
  • Translate funnel and survey data into hypotheses that explain the "why" behind behavioral signals
  • Manage global research panels and survey vendors across US and APAC

Skills

  • Quantitative research design — segmentation (cluster, latent class), conjoint, Max Diff, survey methodology, sampling design
  • Statistical analysis in R, Python, or SPSS — regression, factor analysis, significance testing, weighting
  • Survey platform fluency — Qualtrics, Typeform, Survey Monkey, or equivalent
  • Mixed-methods integration — ability to triangulate quant findings with qualitative signals into a single narrative
  • Voice of Consumer program design — longitudinal tracking, sentiment monitoring, structured feedback loops
  • Data visualization and stakeholder storytelling — comfort with Tableau, Looker, or similar; ability to present to non-technical executives
  • Global panel and vendor management — sample sourcing, quality control, fielding across multiple markets

Personality Traits

  • Bridges quant and qual instinctively — neither tribe owns them
  • Genuinely curious about consumer behavior, not just numbers
  • Comfortable challenging stakeholder assumptions with evidence
  • Operates with intellectual humility — distinguishes signal from noise, flags uncertainty honestly
  • Collaborative across functions — researchers, data scientists, PMs, marketers
  • Adaptable across cultural contexts; sensitive to nuance in how consumers in different markets respond to research instruments
  • Bias toward shipping insight, not perfecting decks
  • Self-directed; can scope and run studies with light oversight

Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of consumer insights, market research, or quantitative UX research experience
  • Bachelor's or Master's in a quantitative or behavioral discipline (Statistics, Psychology, Sociology, Economics, HCI, or related)
  • Demonstrated mixed-methods orientation — quant-led but conversant with qualitative methods
  • Cross-cultural research experience strongly preferred; APAC exposure (Japan, Korea, SEA) a significant plus
  • Experience working with consumer tech, mobile, content, or commerce products
  • Track record of research that influenced product or marketing decisions (portfolio or case examples required)

About Glance

Glance is a consumer technology platform reaching hundreds of millions of users across Android, i OS, and TV in the US and Asia. Our products surface content, commerce, and AI-powered experiences across mobile lock screens, connected televisions, and ambient surfaces — the moments where consumer attention begins. We sit at the intersection of AI, behavioural science, and consumer psychology, which means research here is never decorative: it directly shapes what gets built and how it reaches people.

About the Team

The Foresight & Behavioral Insights Unit exists to decode how consumers behave, think, and evolve — and to make that intelligence an unfair advantage for Glance. The team spans consumer understanding, market intelligence, experimentation, and Voice of Consumer programs. We work closely with Product, Growth, Marketing, and Data Science, and our output shows up in strategy decks, product roadmaps, and partner conversations alike.

Our market is the United States; the team operates in-office out of Bangalore. Bridging that geographic and cultural distance is part of the craft.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Mixed Methods Researcher to bridge the qualitative-quantitative divide on the team and act as the senior research voice into Product, Growth, and Data Science on our most strategic questions. This is a senior individual contributor role with mentoring responsibility — you'll set the bar for how the team approaches mixed-methods work and how it integrates AI into the research craft.

What You'll Do

Strategic & Mixed-Methods Research Leadership

  • Design and lead mixed-methods research programs across Consumer Understanding, experimentation, and strategic research — from problem framing through fieldwork to recommendation
  • Conduct grounded theory-style strategic research where the question is open-ended and the answer needs framing as much as evidence
  • Inform experiment design with behavioural science principles and lead post-experiment interpretation — why something worked, why it didn't, and what to test next

Hypothesis Generation & Data Partnership

  • Generate hypotheses for Data Science from qualitative signals; investigate anomalies in product and funnel data to surface the "why" behind the numbers
  • Partner with Product, Growth, and Data Science on funnel behaviour, decision heuristics, and cohort identification
  • Read quantitative outputs critically rather than deferentially — cross-check the stories the data tells

Mentoring & Methodological Bar-Setting

  • Mentor existing UX researchers on methodology, study design, stakeholder engagement, and AI fluency
  • Set the bar for how the team approaches mixed-methods work — what good looks like, where rigour is non-negotiable, where speed wins
  • Set the bar for how the team uses AI in research — evaluating tools, building or adopting workflows, teaching what good AI-augmented research looks like in practice
  • Author internal frameworks and playbooks that lift the team's collective craft

How You Work With AI

AI is a daily research tool on this team and a primary signal we hire on at this level. Senior researchers here are past the experimentation phase, with non-trivial integration in their own work and the judgment to teach the team what good AI-augmented research looks like.

In interview, we will ask for specifics:

  • Workflows you've built or adopted, and what they actually do for you
  • A case where you caught the model getting something wrong, and how
  • A case where you updated a thesis because the model was right and you were wrong
  • Where AI sharpens research, and where it would degrade it if used uncritically

Bonus: you have built prompt chains, agent pipelines, or research-specific evaluations.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 7+ years in user, consumer, or behavioural research, with at least 3 years leading studies that integrate qualitative and quantitative methods
  • Demonstrated cross-cultural research experience — direct US fieldwork, prior US consumer research practice, or a clear track record of bridging geographic and cultural distance in research
  • Strong grounding in behavioural science — decision heuristics, judgment under uncertainty, and at least one applied framework you use rigorously
  • Comfort working with data teams: able to translate qualitative signals into testable hypotheses and to read quantitative outputs critically rather than deferentially
  • Track record of recommendations being adopted by product or marketing teams, with examples you can walk through
  • Mentoring experience — formal or informal — with junior researchers
  • A hustler's instinct, voracious curiosity, and a fast-learning habit — you don't wait for full briefs to start investigating, you read widely across methods and adjacent disciplines, and you set this tone for the team rather than just embodying it yourself

Preferred

  • Background in consumer tech, commerce, or content/discovery products
  • Experience with agentic commerce, conversational AI, or shopping-with-AI categories
  • Direct experience researching US consumers from outside the US
  • Track record of research that shaped strategic or leadership decisions, not only feature-level product execution
  • Experience working closely with Data Science or ML teams — informing model evaluation, training data quality, or AI product evaluation from a research lens
  • Strong command of longitudinal qualitative methods — diary studies, ethnographic research, or extended panel work
  • Public research output: published papers, conference talks, or substantive contributions to research methodology
  • Comfort with research stacks common to remote-heavy practice — dscout, Userlytics, Maze, Qualtrics, Lyssna, UXtweak, or equivalents

Why This Role

  • You'll shape methodological practice across a growing research team — the senior research voice the team is currently missing
  • Senior IC role with mentoring, no people-management overhead — your craft remains your own
  • The team's AI practice is yours to set the bar on — leeway to define what good looks like, not inherit it
  • Direct line into Product, Growth, and Data Science — your hypotheses get tested, your recommendations move things
  • Glance operates at scale most teams never see — your work covers a user base in the hundreds of millions

Senior Motion Graphics Artist, Glance

Who are we and what do we do?

Glance is an AI-powered digital content and discovery platform integrated natively onto the smartphone lockscreen. Operating as a subsidiary of the In Mobi Group—consistently recognised on both the CNBC Disruptor 50 list and as one of Fast Company’s World’s Most Innovative Companies—Glance has fundamentally redefined how digital experiences are consumed. Your design choices will instantly shape one of the largest and most frequent digital footprints in the mobile ecosystem.

Who will do well in this role?

This role is for an elite motion designer who understands that movement in a user interface is not decoration—it is meaning. The right individual brings deep kinetic restraint, choreographic rhythm, spatial judgment, and physical intuition. You know exactly how motion can reduce cognitive friction, improve structural orientation, establish system responsiveness, and define the emotional signature of an interface. On an ambient surface like the lockscreen, motion is central to how the product communicates elegance and responsiveness.

What will you work on?

  • Architect the Kinetic Signature: Define, maintain, and elevate the unified motion language, choreographed transitions, and physics engines across Glance’s mobile surfaces. Your work will span everything from micro-interactions and tactile feedback loops to rich, immersive visual narratives.
  • Integrate Motion Early: Partner intimately with UX, Visual Design, Product, and Engineering from the initial ideation phase, ensuring that motion is treated as an architectural foundation of the user journey rather than a cosmetic addition at the end of a sprint.
  • Systematise Repeatable Behaviour: Create reusable, scalable motion principles, interpolation curves, timing guidelines, and asset packages that allow other product teams to scale consistent kinetic behaviour across features and use cases.
  • Bridge Concept to Code: Build high-fidelity interactive prototypes to test real feel and collaborate directly with front-end Android engineers to translate motion paths into production code without loss of visual fidelity.
  • Mentor and Inspire: Guide, structure, and educate junior designers within the studio on the principles of UI motion, framing motion as an instrument of clarity and brand expression.
  • Represent the Studio: Share your insights, workflow methodologies, and Glance’s motion innovation both internally to the larger In Mobi organisation and externally within the broader global design community.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Motion Product Portfolio: A collection of work showcasing interactive prototyping, UI animation, kinetic system frameworks, or transition choreographies embedded within shipped software or applications.
  • Kinetic Physics & Timing: Deep structural mastery of easing curves, interpolation, velocity, spatial tracking, and visual storytelling inside confined mobile environments.
  • Advanced Tooling Expertise: High proficiency with After Effects, Figma, Principle, Proto Pie, or equivalent interactive prototyping ecosystems.
  • Technical Communication: Ability to communicate complex motion parameters, frame constraints, and behaviour definitions precisely to engineering partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Native familiarity with gesture tracking, system windows, and navigation transitions native to modern Android OS distributions.
  • Experience building and maintaining code-exportable animation pipelines (e.g., Lottie, custom vector drawables, or native engine transition values) to ensure pixel-perfect deployment.
  • A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Post-Graduate degree in Animation, Media Arts, Interactive Design, Film/Video Design, or an equivalent technical creative field.

Senior Visual Designer, Glance

Location: Bangalore, India

Who are we and what do we do?

Glance is an AI-powered digital content and discovery platform integrated natively onto the smartphone lockscreen. Operating as a subsidiary of the In Mobi Group - consistently recognised on both the CNBC Disruptor 50 list and as one of Fast Company’s World’s Most Innovative Companies - Glance has fundamentally redefined how digital experiences are consumed. Consistently featured among the “Great Places to Work” in India, our culture is our true north, enabling us to think big, solve complex challenges, and grow with new opportunities.

Today, Glance is building an entirely new way to discover and shop. Our commerce experiences are designed to feel personal, visual, and fluid - moving beyond traditional, intent-based search into a world of inspiration-led discovery. Rooted in fashion and expanding into broader lifestyle journeys, the work sits at the precise intersection of systemic product thinking, premium aesthetic taste, and massive engineering scale.

The Reality of Our Scale: Glance is a structural market force pre-installed on over 450 million smartphones globally, serving more than 235 million active users who engage with our surfaces natively out of the box. Your design choices will instantly shape one of the largest and most frequent digital footprints in the mobile ecosystem.

Who will do well in this role?

This role is for a visual designer with exceptional aesthetic taste and a structured, system-oriented brain. You understand completely that visual design is not superficial decoration—it is a core linguistic pillar of how a digital product communicates, commands focus, establishes instant trust, and creates consumer desire. Because Glance is rooted in lifestyle curation and visual inspiration, the bar for your typography, composition, colour application, and asset consistency is naturally world-class.

What will you work on?

  • Shape the Visual Identity: Define, craft, and elevate the premium high-fidelity expression of Glance across our core commerce layouts, key product interfaces, and system component behaviour.
  • Build and Scale Visual Design Systems: Evolve, document, and manage our visual tokens, typographic scales, and UI component behaviour across Android and i OS platforms. You will know exactly when a design requires strict system consistency versus when it needs artistic contrast and contextual emphasis.
  • Cross-Functional Articulation: Partner closely with UX, Motion, Product, and Engineering to ensure that shipped code perfectly mirrors your visual intent, strategic thinking, and aesthetic refinement.

  • Design Evangelism: Champion the business value of premium interface aesthetics internally and represent Glance's unique visual system paradigms at external industry design conferences and creative forums.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Pristine Visual Portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating world-class graphic craft, advanced composition, layout sophistication, and an editorial eye applied to digital screens or consumer products.
  • Interface Fundamentals: Absolute command over typography, grid systems, aspect ratios, color theory, and optical alignment.
  • Systemic Thinking: Proven experience designing UI component systems that adapt gracefully across varying screen densities, aspect ratios, hardware limitations, and localised multi-lingual feeds.
  • Tooling Fluency: Expert command of Figma and modern asset optimisation pipelines, with an obsessive eye for the 1px details that separate standard layouts from elite software products.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated history of designing for visual-first, style, luxury, or fashion-led digital media platforms where imagery, curation, and brand aesthetics are inseparable from product utility.
  • Proven ability to work side-by-side with engineering teams to inspect, review, and refine shipped production UI, ensuring absolute visual fidelity.

What you will be doing

We are looking for a Data Scientist who can operate at the intersection of classical machine learning, large-scale recommendation systems, and modern agentic AI systems.

You will design, build, and deploy intelligent systems that power Glance’s personalized lock screen and live entertainment experiences. This role blends deep ML craftsmanship with forward-looking innovation in autonomous/agentic systems.

Your responsibilities will include:

Classical ML & Recommendation Systems

  • Design and develop large-scale recommendation systems using advanced ML, statistical modeling, ranking algorithms, and deep learning.
  • Build and operate machine learning models on diverse, high-volume data sources for personalization, prediction, and content understanding.
  • Develop rapid experimentation workflows to validate hypotheses and measure real-world business impact.
  • Own data preparation, model training, evaluation, and deployment pipelines in collaboration with engineering counterparts.
  • Monitor ML model performance using statistical techniques; identify drifts, failure modes, and improvement opportunities.

Agentic Systems & Next-Gen AI

  • Build and experiment with agentic AI systems that autonomously observe model performance, trigger experiments, tune hyperparameters, improve ranking policies, or orchestrate ML workflows with minimal human intervention.
  • Apply LLMs, embeddings, retrieval-augmented architectures, and multimodal generative models for semantic understanding, content classification, and user preference modeling.
  • Design intelligent agents that can automate repetitive decision-making tasks—e.g., candidate generation tuning, feature selection, or context-aware content curation.
  • Explore reinforcement learning, contextual bandits, and self-improving systems to power next-generation personalization.

Cross-functional impact

  • Collaborate with Designers, UX Researchers, Product Managers, and Software Engineers to integrate ML and Gen AI-driven features into Glance’s consumer experiences.
  • Contribute to Glance’s ML/AI thought leadership—blogs, case studies, internal tech talks, and industry conferences.
  • Thrive in a multi-functional, highly collaborative team environment with engineering, product, business, and creative teams.
  • Plus: Interface with stakeholders across Product, Business, Data, and Infrastructure to align ML initiatives with strategic priorities.

The experience we need

We are seeking candidates with deep expertise in ML, recommendation systems, and a strong appetite for building agentic AI systems.

You should have experience with:

  • Large-scale ML and recommendation systems (collaborative filtering, ranking models, content-based approaches, embeddings).
  • Classical ML and deep learning techniques across NLP, sequence modeling, RL, clustering, and time series.
  • Experience in deploying ML workflows/models in production system
  • Big data processing (Spark, distributed data systems) and cloud computing.
  • Designing end-to-end ML solutions—from prototype to production.
  • Plus: Building or experimenting with LLMs, generative models, and agentic AI workflows (e.g., autonomous evaluators, self-improving pipelines, automated experiment agents).

We value curiosity, problem-solving ability, and a strong bias toward experimentation and production impact.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Operations Research, Economics, Analytics, or related fields. Ph D is a plus.
  • 6+ years of industry experience in ML/Data Science, ideally in large-scale recommendation systems or personalization.
  • Experience with LLMs, retrieval systems, generative models, or agentic/autonomous ML systems is highly desirable.
  • Expertise with algorithms in NLP, Reinforcement Learning, Time Series, and Deep Learning, applied on real-world datasets.
  • Proficient in Python and comfortable with statistical tools (R, Num Py, Sci Py, Py Torch/Tensor Flow, etc.).
  • Strong experience with the big data ecosystem (Spark, Hadoop) and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP/Vertex AI).
  • Comfortable working in cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with privacy-preserving ML and identity-less ecosystems (especially on i OS and Android).
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.

The Foresight & Behavioral Insights Unit exists to decode how consumers behave, think, and evolve — and to make that intelligence an unfair advantage for Glance. The team spans consumer understanding, market intelligence, experimentation, and Voice of Consumer programs. We work closely with Product, Growth, Marketing, and Data Science, and our output shows up in strategy decks, product roadmaps, and partner conversations alike.

The Role

We're looking for a UX Researcher who owns the quantitative layer of our consumer research practice — designing studies, building segmentation frameworks, and producing the behavioral intelligence that Growth and Leadership act on. This role sits at the heart of how we understand our users at scale, and it's expanding: we want someone who can go beyond quant when the question demands it.

What You'll Do

Research Design & Execution

  • Design and run quantitative consumer research studies — surveys, panel studies, in-app intercepts, and longitudinal tracking programs
  • Own the Voice of Consumer program: structured feedback loops, sentiment tracking, and behavioral shift monitoring across our user base
  • Develop survey instruments that meet the methodological bar for both speed and rigour

Segmentation & Behavioral Intelligence

  • Build and maintain behavioural segmentation frameworks and cohort profiles in collaboration with Data Science
  • Identify decision heuristics, usage patterns, and attitudinal clusters that explain how different user groups engage with the product
  • Generate hypotheses for the data team based on qualitative and survey signals

Stakeholder Enablement

  • Translate behavioral data into clear, actionable recommendations for Growth, Leadership, and Marketing
  • Provide consumer context for growth initiatives, A/B test design, and conversion/drop-off investigations
  • Brief BD and Account Management teams on user voice for OEM and partner conversations

Research Operations

  • Manage relationships with external research panel vendors and participant recruitment pipelines
  • Maintain quality standards across vendor-sourced studies and ensure data integrity

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 3–6 years of experience in consumer/market research with a strong quantitative focus
  • Proven ability to design, field, and analyse quantitative consumer studies end-to-end (surveys, panels, behavioral data)
  • Experience building or contributing to consumer segmentation and cohort-based analysis
  • Comfort working cross-functionally — you've presented findings to Growth, Product, or Leadership and influenced decisions
  • Experience managing external research vendors or panel providers
  • Strong written communication: you can turn a complex dataset into a one-page brief that a non-researcher will act on

Preferred

  • Experience adapting research for cross-cultural or international markets
  • Global panel management experience: recruiting and managing multi-country participant panels
  • Exposure to qualitative methods (IDIs, diary studies, focus groups) — you don't need to be a qual specialist, but you know when to use them
  • Background in consumer tech, mobile products, or digital platforms
  • Familiarity with behavioral economics frameworks or decision heuristics research

Why This Role

  • Your work lands in product roadmaps and marketing strategy — not slide archives
  • You'll work closely with Data Science on user profiling and hypothesis generation, not in isolation from the data layer
  • The unit is scaling: you're joining at a moment when the team and its charter are both expanding
  • Consumer foresight is positioned as a strategic differentiator here, not a support function
  • Glance operates at genuine scale — your insights cover a user base in the hundreds of millions
